domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split was found in any accessible source. Search tooling was unavailable (DuckDuckGo/searx returned 'Connection refused' on both queries), and volza, eximpedia and trademo free views all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, so domestic supply could not be checked. Note the company's own import pattern (PE plank hot-air laminator QB-CS-HAL, computerized panel cutter HY-QG-6, flanging machine, gearbox, humidifier — HS 8477/8451/8452/8479) is consistent with an operating foam/plank manufacturing plant at the Delhi address, but that is inference from inbound machinery, not evidence of domestic supply.
note: Declared HS 392119 (cellular polyurethane/plastic sheets) is NOT contradicted by the customs data: the visible records are capital equipment imports (HS 84799090, 84779000, 84778090, 84515000, 84522900), not the company's own output, so no HS correction is warranted and no rejection ground exists. Factual shipment position: no export shipment record with date, destination, HS code and B/L number was found — the 33-record set visible on ImportKey is inbound only, and the Nepal/Qatar/USA counterparties appear solely in an undated aggregated buyers block, so exports are 'declared, not confirmed'. Domestic supply: no traces of supply found in accessible sources (GST turnover, GeM/CPPP, contracts all null) — this is a data-access gap, not a negative finding, and should be re-checked when search and paid trade views are available. Revenue and export volume: null, not public in the sources read. No CIN/PAN was claimed and none was found; not invented.
